orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sudhanshu Dhulia
orders.text:
FA No. 45 of 2017
Hon’ble Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.
Mr. Sanpreet Singh Azmani, 
Advocate along with Mr. B.D. Pande, 
Advocate for the appellants. 
Mr. Sidhdartha Singh, Advocate 
along with Mr. P.S. Bisht, Advocate for 
the respondent. 
Having heard the rival 
contentions of learned counsels of both 
the parties, this Court is not inclined to 
disclose the detailed reasons 
highlighting all the merits of the 
controverting proceedings between the 
parties for the last two decades, lest it 
may decide the destiny of this appeal 
forthwith. 
So, I admit this appeal. Other 
party has already appeared. 
Summon the lower court record. 
List this first appeal soon after 
the LCR is received for final arguments. 
Meanwhile, both the parties shall 
maintain the status quo on the property 
in question. Neither of them shall create 
any third party interest/encumbrance 
in any manner, whatsoever. They shall 
not change the nature of the property as 
well, in any manner during the 
pendency of this first appeal but, at the 
same time, the court expects that the 
appellant/plaintiff will not prolong the 
pendency of this first appeal 
unnecessarily in future. 
 (Servesh Kumar Gupta, J.) 
 18 .4.2017 
Pooja

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
FA No. 45 of 2017
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma, J.
Mr. Sanpreet Singh Ajmani, learned Advocate 
for the appellants. 
Mr. Maneesh Juyal and Mr. Bhuwan Bhatt, 
learned Advocates for the respondents. 
Respondents filed the objection against the 
application filed under Order 41 Rule 27 of the Code 
of Civil Procedure, 1908. 
Heard. 
If any application is filed under Order 41 Rule 
27 of the Code of Civil Procedure in an appeal, it is 
incumbent on the part of the appellate court to 
consider the same at the time of hearing the appeal 
on merits so as to find out whether the proposed 
documents sought to be filed have any relevance in 
the issue involved and whether the application is 
bona fide. Therefore, put up the application under 
Order 41 Rule 27 of the Code of Civil Procedure with 
arguments of the parties on merits. 
Heard in-part.
Post this case on 17.08.2019 for remaining oral 
arguments in the daily cause list as a first case. 
Meanwhile, parties may file written arguments. 
Interim order dated 18.04.2017 is extended till 
tomorrow. 
 (Alok Kumar Verma, J.)
